prompt: Image 1 is one of our finished point-and-click adventure game backgrounds. Make exactly this local change: Remove the free-standing wooden desk on the left of the back wall (below the key cabinet, in front of the lower half of the plain single wooden door) together with the green desk lamp on it, its shadow and its reflection on the floor. Where it stood, continue exactly what is behind it: the lower part of that single door with its brown frame down to the floor, the yellow wall with the darker yellow-ochre dado, the diagonal bands of sunlight on the wall, the brown skirting board and the polished terrazzo floor with the same tile joints, sun patches and reflections. Change nothing else: keep every other object, the camera, the composition, all positions, sizes, colours and the light exactly as in image 1. No people, no animals, no text, no logos, no frames. Image 2 is another background from the same game: keep the same painting technique. Style: classic 1990s hand-painted adventure game background. Rich painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions with gently curved lines, warm late-afternoon sunlight, saturated but harmonious colours, soft dappled shadows under the trees.
